chapter_seo_title: Han Li Gets a Desperate Offer & a Way Home | A Record of a Mortal's Journey Ch. 565
chapter_meta_description: Recognized by scent, Han Li is cornered by Madam Fan. She offers him a way back to the Inner Sea in exchange for the head of her puppet master. Will he take the deal?
og_title: A Scent of Trouble – Han Li’s Path Home is Paved with Blood
og_description: Recognized by her nose, Han Li is faced with a deal he can’t refuse: escape the Outer Sea in exchange for a timely assassination. Will he risk it?
twitter_title: Han Li’s disguise fails! Madam Fan smells a secret.
twitter_description: Cornered by a desperate ally, Han Li learns a way home… if he’s willing to kill for it. A deadly deal is struck in Chapter 565.

lore_anchors.definition: The renowned Chinese xianxia novel by Wang Yu, famous for its ‘Mortal Stream’ sub-genre, focusing on a pragmatic protagonist’s survival in a harsh cultivation world.
A fearsome nickname for a mysterious cultivator who uses a swarm of deadly spirit insects to kill, a rumor directly tied to Han Li’s identity.
A rare and essential material for constructing long-distance teleportation arrays, its scarcity is a major plot point in this arc.
The central and more established region of the Chaotic Star Sea, where the main teleportation back to the Tian Luo Continent is located, representing Han Li’s goal.
The dangerous, frontier region of the Chaotic Star Sea where Han Li is stranded, characterized by frequent beast tides and weaker power structures.
